description: Send one signed webhook.test event to an active endpoint now and record the result as a delivery, so you can check it receives and verifies events. Read the outcome with list_webhook_deliveries. Needs a key with no scope limits or a person's sign-in. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

webhook_id.description: The webhook endpoint UUID: id on a list_webhooks result.

name: ping_webhook
